create_mineru_loader_local: create a MinerULoader instance with local API mode to parse a PDF document into markdown
create_mineru_loader_cloud: create a MinerULoader instance with cloud API mode and an API key to parse a document asynchronously
run_mineru_loader_load: run the MinerULoader load method to convert a document file into a LangChain Document with markdown content
review_mineru_loader_local_api: review the MinerULoader _load_local_api method that posts a file to a self-hosted MinerU API endpoint
review_mineru_loader_cloud_api: review the MinerULoader _load_cloud_api method that uploads to a presigned URL and polls for batch processing results
